, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the UK label purchased by CBS was “CBS Records (UK),” conflating the post-acquisition renamed entity with the actual label acquired. Sources clearly state CBS bought Oriole Records in 1964; thus substituting “CBS Records (UK)” misidentifies the purchased label and diverges from the correct answer, Oriole Records.
